condo: Cheap city fringe 2 bed , high rental

history.summary: A marketing-named listing ("Cheap city fringe 2 bed, high rental") at $1.6M / $2,477 PSF for a 646 sqft 2BR essentially on top of One-North MRT — this is a new-launch-tier PSF (almost certainly One-North Eden / Blossoms by the Park territory). Genuinely strong tenant demand from the One-North tech/biomed cluster, but the PSF is rich and the dossier carries no project name, no built_year and no URA data.
history.rating_rationale: Location is excellent for rental: One-North MRT at the doorstep, deep tenant pool from biomedical/tech employers, D05 RCR (~5.8%/yr baseline). But $2,477 PSF is new-launch pricing, leaving little appreciation headroom once developer premium is paid, and 99LH erodes from a high base. The opaque marketing name, missing built_year and absent URA transaction data prevent a confident buy call. The 2BR/646 sqft format is liquid and rentable, but at $1.6M the entry is full.
red_flags: $2,477 PSF is full new-launch pricing — thin appreciation margin
No project name, no built_year, no URA data in dossier
99-year leasehold bought at a premium PSF
Listing title is marketing copy, not a verified development
catalysts: One-North MRT at the doorstep — One-North biomedical/tech jobs drive consistent rental demand
D05 RCR with One-North/Greater One-North growth narrative
Compact 2BR is the most liquid rental format
